article_title: 'I started in my 20s and made £8,000': Why women are often better investors than men

tasks.prompt: What is the main argument examined in the article?
options: Men and women always choose identical investments
Research often finds women achieve better investment returns because of differences in behaviour and strategy
Only professional investors can make long-term profits
Investing in cash always produces the highest return
tasks.correct_answer: Research often finds women achieve better investment returns because of differences in behaviour and strategy
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בוחנת מחקרים שלפיהם נשים משיגות לעיתים תשואות טובות יותר, בעיקר בזכות סבלנות, פחות מסחר וגישה ארוכת טווח.

tasks.prompt: What result did the woman highlighted in the headline report?
options: She lost £8,000 after starting in her 50s
She earned £800 in one day of trading
She began investing in her 20s and made about £8,000
She borrowed £8,000 to buy one speculative share
tasks.correct_answer: She began investing in her 20s and made about £8,000
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כותרת הכתבה מציגה אישה שהחלה להשקיע בשנות העשרים לחייה והרוויחה כ־8,000 ליש״ט.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what are investment “returns”?
options: The number of times an investor checks an account
Money withdrawn from a bank before investing
Goods sent back to a shop
Gains or losses produced by invested money
tasks.correct_answer: Gains or losses produced by invested money
tasks.explanation_hebrew: returns הן התשואות — השינוי בערך הכסף שהושקע, כרווח או כהפסד.

tasks.prompt: Which behaviour is associated with women's stronger average performance in the research discussed?
options: Trading less frequently and keeping a longer-term perspective
Buying only very low-priced speculative shares
Selling every investment after a small fall
Ignoring diversification and concentrating on one company
tasks.correct_answer: Trading less frequently and keeping a longer-term perspective
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המחקרים קושרים את הביצועים הטובים יותר למסחר פחות תכוף, פחות תגובות אימפולסיביות וסבלנות לאורך זמן.

tasks.prompt: Why can frequent trading reduce long-term returns?
options: It guarantees that share prices will fall
Repeated decisions and costs can erode gains, especially when driven by overconfidence
It prevents investors from seeing their account balance
Regulators ban investors who trade every month
tasks.correct_answer: Repeated decisions and costs can erode gains, especially when driven by overconfidence
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מסחר תכוף עלול להוסיף עלויות ולעודד החלטות גרועות של תזמון השוק, ולכן לפגוע בתשואה המצטברת.

tasks.prompt: What does “cumulative” mean when describing investment returns?
options: Guaranteed by the government
Measured for one trading day only
Built up over time from a series of gains and losses
Hidden from the investor
tasks.correct_answer: Built up over time from a series of gains and losses
tasks.explanation_hebrew: cumulative פירושו מצטבר; תשואה מצטברת כוללת את ההשפעה המתמשכת של רווחים והפסדים לאורך זמן.

tasks.prompt: Give two differences between the investment approaches attributed to women and men in the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שתי השוואות הנתמכות בכתבה, בלי לטעון שכל אדם מתנהג לפי הממוצע הקבוצתי.
expected_points: Women were found to trade less frequently on average
Women tended to take a more patient, long-term approach
Men were more likely to choose speculative or lottery-style shares
Women showed more restraint during market fluctuations

tasks.prompt: Summarise the article's evidence, explanation and caution in 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את ממצאי הביצועים, ההסבר ההתנהגותי, חסם בפני נשים והסתייגות מהכללה גורפת.
expected_points: Several analyses suggest women investors outperform men on average
Lower trading frequency and a long-term approach may explain part of the difference
Patience and restraint can support compounding and reduce avoidable mistakes
Women have historically held less wealth and may feel less confident about investing
Group averages do not predict every individual investor's results

tasks.prompt: Why might lower confidence sometimes improve performance but also prevent women from investing at all?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את שני הכיוונים המנוגדים של זהירות: הפחתת ביטחון־יתר מול הימנעות מהשקעה.
expected_points: Less overconfidence may reduce impulsive trades and speculative choices
Caution can encourage research and a disciplined plan
Too little confidence may keep money out of investments with long-term growth potential
Accessible education could preserve discipline while reducing unnecessary fear

tasks.prompt: Using the article, propose three principles for a beginner's long-term investment approach.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע שלושה עקרונות שמבוססים על רעיונות הכתבה, תוך הימנעות מהבטחת רווח.
expected_points: Invest regularly and think in years rather than reacting to daily movements
Use diversified funds or a spread of assets rather than speculative single bets
Avoid unnecessary frequent trading and associated costs
Invest only after understanding risk and maintaining suitable emergency savings
